ODIBO PDF — unsigned Windows x64 engineering test build

Extract the whole ZIP to a writable folder and run odibo-pdf.exe.
The CLI is odibo-pdf-cli.exe. Keep models/, licences/, THIRD_PARTY_CARGO.html,
LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE and attribution files with the executables.
portable.txt keeps settings, logs, recovery and new digital IDs in ODIBOPDFData.
Without that marker, ODIBO uses its own per-user directories; PdfCraft data is not migrated.

Updates are disabled: no ODIBO update service is configured. No installer, signing
identity or official release is included. Do not use irreplaceable originals for testing.

Code retains MIT OR Apache-2.0 and upstream copyright notices. ODIBO graphics have
separate terms in licences/assets/odibo/LICENSE-ODIBO-BRAND.txt. Fonts, components
and OCR models retain their own licences. No exclusive AI copyright is claimed.

BUILD_INFO.txt records the source commit. SHA256SUMS.txt covers the package files.
The GitHub Actions artifact ZIP requires GitHub sign-in and expires after seven days.
